content:
Tessa: Observed a burst of reconnects + jittered SSE resumes this morning on us-east routes after the routing-policy rollout. Clients show resume success but see duplicated partial payloads.
Alok: which policy change? the weighted-pref local rollout?
Tessa: yes, runtime/routing/2026-03-28/weight-local; it prefers underutilized nodes more aggressively. We see more session migrations.
Ruth: logs look like resume routed to new node while previous node still had inflight chunk(s). sample:
[2026-03-28T10:22:11Z] old=node-e1 emit chunk=17 session=s-99
[2026-03-28T10:22:11Z] router: migrate session=s-99 -> node-e3
[2026-03-28T10:22:11Z] new=node-e3 emit chunk=18 session=s-99
[2026-03-28T10:22:11Z] client_recv chunk=18
[2026-03-28T10:22:12Z] client_recv chunk=17
Tessa: client sees chunk 18 then 17. small windows but still visible to some apps.
Alok: telemetry: console shows per-route inflight_count spikes and quota-bot flagged a short token-surge on those routes. quota-bot: alert: route=us-east.* token_spike > 2x (1m).
Ruth: this ordering can also double-count tokens if billing counts per-chunk on arrival. Ops: can billing do short-window dedupe by (resume_id, chunk_id)?
Tessa: filing infra ticket to make resume handoff stricter for multiplexed streams. Short-term mitigations?
Alok: propose: 1) quick config to reduce handoff grace from 200ms -> 25ms for canary routes, 2) emit telemetry runtime.stream.reorder_handoff and expose in console, 3) small console UX tweak to show a badge on route pages when reorder rate > threshold and a tooltip explaining possible transient inflates.
Ruth: +1. Also add a metric for "billing_risk_suspect" when reorder detected so billing can watch.
DeployBot: started canary deploy: runtime/routing/2026-03-28/ld-tune -> us-east-canary (id: d-10011).
DeployBot: canary finished (3 instances), health ok.
Alok: initial canary telem: reorder_handoff dropped 92% on canary hosts, token_spike normalized. Good signal.
Console (ux): will add the badge + helptext. small frontend PR queued.
quota-bot: note: billing dedupe request filed (ticket #BILL-4821).
Tessa: I'll push a minimal repro and follow up with tradeoffs doc about strict handoff vs tail latency. Thanks all.
